question.text: Under the ITA reporting compliances for an AIF, the statement of income paid or credited to unit-holders must be furnished to the unit-holder in Form 64C by WHICH date, and to the jurisdictional PCIT/CIT electronically in Form 64D by WHICH date, of the following financial year?

answer.text: Form 64C by 30 June; Form 64D by 15 June
Form 64C by 15 June; Form 64D by 30 June
Form 64C by 31 March; Form 64D by 31 March
Form 64C by 31 July; Form 64D by 30 September

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 14: Form 64C (to unit-holders) by 30 June of the following FY; Form 64D (electronic to jurisdictional PCIT/CIT) by 15 June of the following FY, under digital signature and verified by a practicing CA. The Trap: B swaps the two dates — a classic trap. C confuses with FY closing. D uses ITR filing dates. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/XIX-D test the same form dates. XIX-E drills them from the fund-administrator's calendar. Remember the CA-verification requirement — not merely trustee sign-off. Manager's Pro-Tip: Lock both 15 June and 30 June into Aravalli's tax calendar with a one-week buffer. The 64D is electronic to PCIT/CIT with digital signature — keep the digital-signature token and CA engagement letter renewed annually to avoid last-minute breaks.
